title: A person types in the Chief composer on Home; a script's newTab makes a terminal but the person's text stays in the composer and no key reaches the new shell
why: Automation never competes with the person (CLAUDE.md, "Go past Chrome where cmux is scripted"). Since cp/fix-chief-composer-focus only the person's own newTab (key, menu, click, palette) claims the window's keyboard; a script's newTab (the socket, origin script) makes the workspace without showing it while a text input has the person's keyboard. Before it, a script's newTab took the window from a person typing to Chief and their next keys went to the new shell.
source: cp/fix-chief-composer-focus (80723559628): a script's newTab never takes a field the person focused

steps.title: one window on Home, the daemon connected, no workspace but Home
set-up: the person's window is the active app's key window (a capture slot never is; the app's own become-active and become-key notices, NSApp.isActive stays false)
where the keyboard is before the person types
where the keyboard is after the person typed
where the keyboard is after the script's newTab
the script's workspace exists with a working shell that got none of the person's keys; the window stays on Home and the composer shows all the person typed
